seoTitle: VPAT / ACR Builder: WCAG 2.2 Conformance Report Tables
metaDescription: Enter a level and remarks per WCAG 2.2 criterion to get an Accessibility Conformance Report with Level A, AA and AAA tables in Markdown.
intro: Builds a Markdown accessibility conformance report from per-criterion levels and remarks.
why:
Buyers ask for a VPAT or ACR. The tables are long but mechanical.

Write one line per criterion and the tool fills the Level A, AA and AAA tables for all 86 WCAG 2.2 criteria, marks missing ones as Not Evaluated, flags the new 2.2 criteria and counts the totals. Terms follow the ITI VPAT conventions; check the current official template before publishing.
howTo: Fill in product, date and contact.
Write criterion, level and remarks per line.
